links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4o answers to pediatric asthma questions across seven indices
links.effect: FKGL 10.77 ± 1.58; answers required a high level of reading proficiency across indices.
links.quote: The application scored 10.77 ± 1.58 on the FKGL scale, and in conjunction with the other indices, the results indicated that the answers required a high level of reading proficiency.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, reliability, and readability of ChatGPT-4o responses to pediatric asthma questions, but does not test or compare an implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
